lines.text: In 1995, a man bought an entire two hundred year old bank
And the government let him do it.
See, Barings Bank was one of the most prestigious banks on Earth,
managing money for the Queen of England.
Until one rogue trader in Singapore
secretly gambled away eight hundred million pounds.
The entire bank went bankrupt overnight.
Panicked officials desperately looked for a buyer,
but nobody wanted an eight hundred million dollar debt.
Until a clever Dutch banker stepped up,
handed over a single one-dollar coin,
and walked away owning the entire worldwide empire.
Which proves that with enough debt,
even a royal bank costs less than a cup of coffee.
